sources.title: Chactemal (Chetumal)
sources.note: Postclassic state ca. 950-1544; Gonzalo Guerrero 1514; Acalan raid c.1450-1500; Pacheco commissioned April 1543; Salamanca de Bacalar early 1544.

notes: NEW STATE. Cliopatria has no row for this province; Later Mayan City-States (1429-1546, 135,136 to 187,745 km2) covers the whole northern lowlands and contains it. The Kuchkabal page says the extent of the provinces 'is still debated' and that scholars disagree 'on whether they were territorial units or jurisdictions'; the shape here is a disc around the capital, soft, and no frontier is claimed. Cliopatria keeps its envelope to 1546 although the Spanish took the provinces one by one from 1527. CHETUMAL. The page is Wikipedia's 'Chactemal' article (the title 'Chetumal (Maya province)' did not load). Its infobox lists 'ca. 950-1544' with the fragments 'ca. 1441-1446' and 'ca. 1514-1544' unlabelled; 950 is the page's header and a rounded bridge. The state lies partly in Belize. Gonzalo Guerrero entered Chetumal's service in 1514 (no territorial event). Uaymil (Waymil) has no dossier.
